tips.title: Ginger Turmeric Infusion
tips.instructions: Slice 1 inch of fresh ginger root and boil in 2 cups of water for 10 minutes. Add 1/2 teaspoon of pure organic turmeric powder and a pinch of black pepper (to increase curcumin absorption). Simmer for 2 minutes, strain, and stir in raw honey.
tips.benefits: Gingerols in ginger block pain-producing inflammatory pathways (COX-2) similar to NSAIDs, while curcumin in turmeric reduces uterine spasms.

tips.title: Fennel Seed (Saunf) Decoction
tips.instructions: Boil 1 teaspoon of fennel seeds in 1 cup of water for 5 minutes. Strain and drink warm twice a day.
tips.benefits: Fennel contains anethole, a natural muscle relaxant that relieves uterine contractions and eases abdominal bloating.

tips.title: Chamomile & Lavender Tea
tips.instructions: Steep one chamomile tea bag and three dried lavender buds in boiling water for 7 minutes. Drink warm before bed.
tips.benefits: Chamomile contains glycine, which acts as a gentle spasmolytic on uterine walls, and lavender lowers nervous tension.

tips.title: Warm Castor Oil Pack
tips.instructions: Soak a clean flannel cloth in cold-pressed castor oil, apply it directly to the lower abdomen, wrap with a plastic film, and place a hot water bottle over it for 30 minutes.
tips.benefits: Ricinoleic acid in castor oil penetrates tissues to improve lymphatic flow, clear congestion, and relax pelvic muscles.

tips.title: Peppermint Oil Inhalation
tips.instructions: Diffuse 4 drops of peppermint essential oil in your room, or dilute 1 drop with coconut oil and gently massage onto your temples or lower back.
tips.benefits: Menthol creates a cooling sensation, blocks pain receptors, and helps relieve headaches and muscle fatigue.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Stretch (Marjaryasana)
steps: Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position.
Inhale, drop your belly, and lift your chin and tailbone (Cow pose).
Exhale, draw your belly button to your spine, and round your back toward the ceiling (Cat pose).
Repeat smoothly in coordination with your breath for 5 minutes.
exercises.benefits: Stretches the spine, pelvis, and neck, easing tension in the lower back and opening the pelvic area.

exercises.name: Child's Pose (Balasana)
steps: Kneel on the floor, touch your big toes together, and sit on your heels.
Separate your knees about hip-width apart.
Exhale and lay your torso down between your thighs, stretching your arms out front.
Rest your forehead on the mat and hold for deep restorative breathing.
exercises.benefits: Gently stretches the hips, thighs, and lower back. Calms the central nervous system and relieves severe cramps.

exercises.name: Restorative Cycle Flow
steps: Begin sitting comfortably with your spine erect.
Gently roll your shoulders clockwise and counterclockwise to release upper body stress.
Extend your legs forward, and slide your hands down toward your shins in a gentle seated forward fold.
Lie on your back, bring the soles of your feet together, and let your knees fall open (Supta Baddha Konasana).
exercises.benefits: Promotes pelvic circulation, relieves abdominal pressure, and restores overall energy levels.
